product_risk_or_requirement: A configured emergency red flag can receive self-care text, an unclear emergency instruction, or an inappropriate nurse-handoff promise.
current_state: No clinician-approved red-flag taxonomy, consent branch, staffed-hours coverage rule, or end-to-end emergency test exists.
product_requirement: The product must never provide self-care-only advice for a configured emergency red flag; it must present immediate emergency action and send a nurse summary only when consent is recorded and the qualified queue is staffed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clinician-approved test conversation contains a configured emergency red flag When the assistant generates a response Then it presents immediate emergency action, suppresses self-care-only advice, and sends a minimal nurse-handoff summary only when recorded consent and a staffed queue are both present; otherwise it does not promise human follow-up and displays emergency or in-hours care contacts.
evidence_needed: Clinician-approved taxonomy; consented, declined-consent, staffed, and unstaffed end-to-end test results; staffing coverage rule; audit sample showing zero configured emergency misses; and independent clinician sign-off.

product_risk_or_requirement: The product has no independent evidence of response safety, calibration, or equitable performance across Vietnamese-language variants, symptom groups, and care-access subgroups.
current_state: Only design assumptions exist; no clinician-labelled validation, pre-specified threshold, subgroup analysis, or independent review has been completed.
product_requirement: The product must pass independent clinical safety, calibration, and subgroup evaluation using approved scripted, synthetic, or separately consented test data before public use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an independently clinician-labelled test set is locked with a pre-specified sampling plan and thresholds When the product is evaluated by Vietnamese-language variant and red-flag category Then an independent clinician signs a report with numerator, denominator, confidence interval, and subgroup gaps; release remains blocked until configured emergency red flags have zero misses and every other threshold breach is remediated and retested.
evidence_needed: Locked protocol; clinician-labelled test set; independent validation report; stratified error and calibration analysis; documented remediation and retest for each threshold breach.

jurisdiction: Vietnam privacy, AI, and health-service governance
product_risk_or_requirement: The final controller and processor roles, consent and retention design, vendor and data locations, health-service boundary, and possible AI high-risk-list applicability are not legally confirmed.
current_state: The final data-flow diagram, intended-purpose assessment, legal opinion, and privacy approval have not been completed.
product_requirement: Legal, privacy, and clinical-regulatory owners must approve a purpose-limited data flow, consent and retention design, health-service boundary, and written intended-purpose assessment before real-user symptom text or referral metadata is processed.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final intended purpose, actor roles, cloud and vendor locations, and data-flow diagram are available When legal, privacy, and clinical-regulatory review occurs Then the owners document controller and processor roles, consent and retention controls, any security or transfer decision, the health-service boundary, and a written determination of whether the AI Law and high-risk list apply before any real-user data is processed or public pilot begins.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any real-user conversation is stored or public pilot begins
evidence_needed: Signed legal and privacy launch memo; intended-purpose and high-risk-list assessment; data-flow and vendor map; approved consent copy; retention and deletion test; documented health-service boundary.

product_risk_or_requirement: Safety signals need a rapid pause authority that is independent of engagement goals and an exercised, independently approved restart gate.
current_state: A weekly review is proposed but no immediate-stop workflow, incident drill, or restart approval has been exercised.
product_requirement: The operating model must let the Clinical Safety Lead stop the affected assistant flow immediately and prevent restart until an independent clinician reviews corrective evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configured emergency miss, unauthorised handoff, unsafe-response finding, or qualifying complaint is recorded When the incident workflow starts Then the Clinical Safety Lead can disable the affected flow immediately, the incident record captures the evidence and decision, and the product cannot restart until an independent licensed clinician records approval of corrective evidence and retest results.
deadline_or_trigger: Before any public pilot and after each qualifying incident
evidence_needed: Timed incident-drill record; immutable pause and restart decision record; corrective-action evidence; independent clinician restart approval.

product_risk_or_requirement: A nurse handoff can be sent without a valid consent record or promised when no qualified nurse is staffed, creating privacy risk, false reliance, and an unowned care gap.
current_state: The prototype has no demonstrated consent capture, minimum-data handoff rule, staffed-hours signal, or test for declined consent and unstaffed states.
product_requirement: The product must transfer only the minimum approved summary after recorded consent and must accurately distinguish staffed from unstaffed care pathways.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configured urgent test interaction is exercised in staffed and unstaffed states with both recorded and declined consent When the assistant responds Then it transfers only the minimum approved summary when consent and staffing are both present; otherwise it sends no handoff, makes no promise of nurse review, and displays the approved emergency or in-hours care route.
owner: Clinic Operations Lead and Privacy Counsel
evidence_needed: Approved consent copy; minimum-data handoff specification; staffed-hours coverage rule; four-state test record; audit sample showing zero unauthorised handoffs; privacy sign-off.
